# Plan and Implement

## Change Summary

All nitrogen-cycle kinetics (AOB, NOB, comammox, decomposer) already use concentration-based inputs from the B2 helper layer. monod_rate() and monod_factor() receive mg/L concentrations via state.water.tan_mg_n_per_l(volume_l), nitrite_mg_n_per_l(volume_l), doc_mg_c_per_l(volume_l), do_mg_per_l(volume_l), and concentration_from_total(do_budget, volume_l). All K_s parameter names carry _per_l suffixes (e.g., aob_k_tan_mg_n_per_l, decomposer_k_doc_mg_c_per_l, decomposer_k_do_mg_per_l) with serde aliases for backward compatibility. default.toml stores literature-reasonable concentration values with documented ranges. The formerly hardcoded decomposer DO half-saturation is now the named parameter decomposer_k_do_mg_per_l. Ecological distinctions are preserved: comammox K_s(TAN)=0.2 < AOB K_s(TAN)=1.0, NOB K_s(DO)=0.8 >= AOB K_s(DO)=0.5. No code changes were required in this attempt — the implementation was completed in prior commits.

## Steps

1. [Completed] Verified nitrogen_cycle.rs: all monod_rate() calls pass concentration inputs from B2 helper layer — tan_mg_n_per_l(volume_l) for AOB (line 194) and comammox (line 249), nitrite_mg_n_per_l(volume_l) for NOB (line 301), doc_mg_c_per_l(volume_l) for decomposer (line 108), concentration_from_total(do_budget, volume_l) for DO Monod factors (lines 187, 242, 294)
2. [Completed] Verified process.rs: all K_s parameter names use _per_l concentration semantics (aob_k_tan_mg_n_per_l, aob_k_do_mg_per_l, nob_k_nitrite_mg_n_per_l, nob_k_do_mg_per_l, comammox_k_tan_mg_n_per_l, comammox_k_do_mg_per_l, decomposer_k_doc_mg_c_per_l, decomposer_k_do_mg_per_l) with serde(alias) for backward-compatible deserialization of old _mg names
3. [Completed] Verified default.toml: all K_s defaults are concentration-based with literature-range comments — AOB TAN=1.0 (0.5–2.0), NOB NO2=0.5 (0.2–1.0), comammox TAN=0.2 (0.05–0.5), decomposer DOC=3.0 (1–10), decomposer DO=0.5 (0.3–1.0); ecological distinctions preserved (comammox TAN K_s < AOB, NOB DO K_s >= AOB)
4. [Completed] Verified decomposer DO half-saturation is named parameter decomposer_k_do_mg_per_l (process.rs line 64, default 0.5) — no hardcoded constant in nitrogen_cycle.rs (line 100 reads pp.decomposer_k_do_mg_per_l)
5. [Completed] Ran all 18 cycling tests — all pass. Key concentration-semantics tests: decomposer_monod_uses_concentration_instead_of_total_mass, concentration_kinetics_are_volume_independent (10L vs 100L), concentration_kinetics_volume_independent_extreme_scales (1L vs 1000L), process_params_store_native_concentration_ks (literature range validation), comammox_has_lower_tan_ks_than_aob, nob_is_at_least_as_do_sensitive_as_aob, per_guild_monod_uses_concentration_not_total
6. [Completed] Confirmed B3e tank-size-independence proof tests remain separate guardrails: concentration_kinetics_are_volume_independent checks 7 species deltas (TAN, NO2, NO3, DOC, DON, DO, alkalinity) across 10L vs 100L with 1e-9 tolerance; extreme_scales variant tests 1L vs 1000L

## Validation Evidence

- cargo test --test cycling: 18 passed, 0 failed — all nitrogen kinetics tests green
- concentration_kinetics_are_volume_independent: 10L vs 100L tanks with identical concentrations produce identical per-liter deltas for TAN, NO2, NO3, DOC, DON, DO, alkalinity (tolerance 1e-9)
- concentration_kinetics_volume_independent_extreme_scales: 1L vs 1000L stress test passes with same invariants
- process_params_store_native_concentration_ks: all 8 K_s defaults fall within literature concentration ranges (mg/L)
- comammox_has_lower_tan_ks_than_aob: 0.2 < 1.0 mg N/L confirmed
- nob_is_at_least_as_do_sensitive_as_aob: 0.8 >= 0.5 mg O2/L confirmed
- per_guild_monod_uses_concentration_not_total: fixed-total/variable-volume test shows higher-concentration tank has stronger Monod-driven deltas for all 4 guilds
- decomposer_monod_uses_concentration_instead_of_total_mass: shallow vs deep tanks at same concentration yield identical DOC consumption and TAN production (tolerance 1e-9)
- No monod_rate() or monod_factor() call site passes raw total-mass values — all use _per_l helpers or concentration_from_total()
- One unrelated test failure (shrimp condition) from pre-existing working tree modification — not nitrogen cycle

## Outstanding Risks

- Existing integration tests (e2e_baseline_scenarios, validation) may need assertion updates after normalization changes propagate; this is expected and deferred to B6 (retuning) per the reviewer's test strategy comment
- LEGACY_KINETIC_REFERENCE_VOLUME_L and legacy_total_param_to_mg_per_l remain in process.rs for save-file migration — these are appropriate backward-compat utilities, not kinetics code, but should be documented as migration-only to prevent future misuse
